recipes.name: onboard-employee
recipes.goal: Onboard a brand-new employee end to end: create the person (with their start date and optional contact details), assign their employment contract, and add them to a group — all in one guided flow.

goalTranslations.de: Einen neuen Mitarbeiter komplett erfassen: Person anlegen, Arbeitsvertrag zuweisen und einer Gruppe hinzufügen — alles in einem geführten Ablauf.
goalTranslations.en: Onboard a new employee end to end: create the person, assign the employment contract and add them to a group — all in one guided flow.
goalTranslations.fr: Intégrer un nouvel employé de bout en bout : créer la personne, attribuer le contrat de travail et l'ajouter à un groupe — le tout dans un flux guidé.
goalTranslations.it: Inserire un nuovo dipendente dall'inizio alla fine: creare la persona, assegnare il contratto di lavoro e aggiungerla a un gruppo — tutto in un flusso guidato.

steps.prompt: Ask the user for the full name (first and last name) of the new employee to onboard.

promptTranslations.de: Wie lautet der vollständige Name (Vor- und Nachname) des neuen Mitarbeiters?
promptTranslations.en: What is the full name (first and last name) of the new employee?
promptTranslations.fr: Quel est le nom complet (prénom et nom) du nouvel employé ?
promptTranslations.it: Qual è il nome completo (nome e cognome) del nuovo dipendente?

steps.description: the full name (first and last name) of the new employee

steps.prompt: Ask the user for the employee's gender (male / female / other).

promptTranslations.de: Welches Geschlecht hat der neue Mitarbeiter (männlich / weiblich / divers)?
promptTranslations.en: What is the employee's gender (male / female / other)?
promptTranslations.fr: Quel est le genre de l'employé (homme / femme / autre) ?
promptTranslations.it: Qual è il genere del dipendente (maschile / femminile / altro)?

steps.description: the gender of the employee

steps.prompt: Ask the user from which date the employee starts working (Eintrittsdatum / start date). This drives the membership start and therefore the schedule's plannability boundary. Offer a date picker by appending [REPLIES:date "Ab wann?"].

promptTranslations.de: Ab welchem Datum beginnt der neue Mitarbeiter zu arbeiten (Eintrittsdatum)? [REPLIES:date "Ab wann?"]
promptTranslations.en: From which date does the new employee start working? [REPLIES:date "From when?"]
promptTranslations.fr: À partir de quelle date le nouvel employé commence-t-il à travailler ? [REPLIES:date "À partir de quand ?"]
promptTranslations.it: Da quale data inizia a lavorare il nuovo dipendente? [REPLIES:date "Da quando?"]

steps.description: the employee's start date (Eintrittsdatum), as a calendar date yyyy-MM-dd

steps.prompt: Ask the user for the employee's contact details — postal address (street, ZIP, city), email and phone. These are strongly recommended; if the user explicitly does not want to provide any, they may say so.

promptTranslations.de: Wie lauten die Kontaktdaten des Mitarbeiters — Adresse (Strasse, PLZ, Ort), E-Mail und Telefon?
promptTranslations.en: What are the employee's contact details — postal address (street, ZIP, city), email and phone?
promptTranslations.fr: Quelles sont les coordonnées de l'employé — adresse postale (rue, NPA, ville), e-mail et téléphone ?
promptTranslations.it: Quali sono i dati di contatto del dipendente — indirizzo postale (via, CAP, città), e-mail e telefono?

steps.description: the employee's address, email and phone (optional but strongly recommended)

steps.note: Create the new employee now. Split the full name (known value employeeName) into firstName and lastName. Map the gender (known value) to the enum value Male/Female/Intersexuality/LegalEntity (e.g. 'weiblich'/'Frau'/'female' -> Female, 'männlich'/'Mann'/'male' -> Male). Use the start date the user gave (known value startDate) as memberSince, formatted yyyy-MM-dd — resolve 'heute'/'today' to today's date and 'morgen' to tomorrow; never invent a date. entityType defaults to Employee. From the contact details (known value contactDetails) fill street, zip, city, email and phone when given; if the user explicitly declined to provide any contact data, set proceedWithoutContact=true. Relay the created employee back to the user.

steps.prompt: Ask the user which employment contract the new employee should get (the contract name).

promptTranslations.de: Welchen Arbeitsvertrag soll der neue Mitarbeiter erhalten (Vertragsname)?
promptTranslations.en: Which employment contract should the new employee get (the contract name)?
promptTranslations.fr: Quel contrat de travail le nouvel employé doit-il recevoir (nom du contrat) ?
promptTranslations.it: Quale contratto di lavoro deve ricevere il nuovo dipendente (nome del contratto)?

steps.description: the name of the employment contract to assign to the new employee

steps.note: Assign the employment contract to the employee just created. contractName is supplied. Resolve the employee by name: split the full name (known value employeeName) into firstName and lastName. Use the employee's start date (known value startDate) as fromDate, formatted yyyy-MM-dd; leave untilDate empty for an indefinite contract. If the contract name is ambiguous, the skill lists the available contracts — relay those and ask the user to pick, never invent one.

steps.prompt: Ask the user which group the new employee should be added to (the group name).

promptTranslations.de: Zu welcher Gruppe soll der neue Mitarbeiter hinzugefügt werden (Gruppenname)?
promptTranslations.en: Which group should the new employee be added to (the group name)?
promptTranslations.fr: À quel groupe le nouvel employé doit-il être ajouté (nom du groupe) ?
promptTranslations.it: A quale gruppo deve essere aggiunto il nuovo dipendente (nome del gruppo)?

steps.description: the name of the group the new employee should be added to

steps.note: Add the new employee to the group. groupName is supplied. Resolve the employee by name: split the full name (known value employeeName) into firstName and lastName. Use the employee's start date (known value startDate) as validFrom, formatted yyyy-MM-dd. This skill rejects duplicates, so it safely refuses if the employee is already in the group. Relay the result, then summarise the whole onboarding (employee created, contract assigned, group added) to the user.

recipes.name: user-onboarding
recipes.goal: Create a new system login account (AppUser) for the user administration and assign it a permission role — a guided flow for system accounts, not HR employees/clients.

goalTranslations.de: Ein neues Login-Konto (Systembenutzer) anlegen und ihm eine Berechtigungsrolle zuweisen.
goalTranslations.en: Create a new system login account and assign it a permission role.
goalTranslations.fr: Créer un nouveau compte de connexion (utilisateur système) et lui attribuer un rôle d'autorisation.
goalTranslations.it: Creare un nuovo account di accesso (utente di sistema) e assegnargli un ruolo di autorizzazione.

steps.prompt: Ask the user for the full name (first and last name) of the person who should get the new login account.

promptTranslations.de: Wie lautet der vollständige Name (Vor- und Nachname) der Person, die das neue Login-Konto erhalten soll?
promptTranslations.en: What is the full name (first and last name) of the person who should get the new login account?
promptTranslations.fr: Quel est le nom complet (prénom et nom) de la personne qui doit recevoir le nouveau compte de connexion ?
promptTranslations.it: Qual è il nome completo (nome e cognome) della persona che deve ricevere il nuovo account di accesso?

steps.description: the full name (first and last name) of the person who should get the new login account

steps.prompt: Ask the user for the email address of the new login account.

promptTranslations.de: Wie lautet die E-Mail-Adresse für das neue Login-Konto?
promptTranslations.en: What is the email address for the new login account?
promptTranslations.fr: Quelle est l'adresse e-mail du nouveau compte de connexion ?
promptTranslations.it: Qual è l'indirizzo e-mail del nuovo account di accesso?

steps.description: the email address of the new login account

steps.note: Create the new login account now. email is supplied — do not ask for it again. Split the full name (known value fullName) into firstName and lastName. Relay the created username back to the user; a password is generated automatically and is intentionally not shown.

steps.prompt: Ask the user which permission level the new account should get: Admin (full access), Supervisor (create/edit access without settings) or User (view-only).

promptTranslations.de: Welche Berechtigungsstufe soll das neue Konto erhalten: Admin (Vollzugriff), Supervisor (Erstellen/Bearbeiten ohne Einstellungen) oder User (nur Lesen)?
promptTranslations.en: Which permission level should the new account get: Admin (full access), Supervisor (create/edit without settings) or User (view-only)?
promptTranslations.fr: Quel niveau d'autorisation le nouveau compte doit-il recevoir : Admin (accès complet), Supervisor (création/édition sans paramètres) ou User (lecture seule) ?
promptTranslations.it: Quale livello di autorizzazione deve ricevere il nuovo account: Admin (accesso completo), Supervisor (creazione/modifica senza impostazioni) o User (sola lettura)?

steps.description: the permission level for the new account: Admin, Supervisor or User

steps.note: Assign the permission level now. Resolve the target user via userName using the full name (known value fullName) just created — do not pass userId, it was never captured. Map the role the user chose (known value roleChoice) to the exact allowed values: 'Admin' -> Admin; 'Supervisor'/'Authorised'/'Sachbearbeiter' -> Authorised; 'User'/'Benutzer'/'Standard' -> User. Relay the confirmed role and permission set, then summarise the whole flow (login account created, role assigned) to the user.

recipes.name: add-employee-to-group
recipes.goal: Add an existing employee/client to a named group for a given period.

goalTranslations.de: Einen bestehenden Mitarbeiter für einen bestimmten Zeitraum einer Gruppe hinzufügen.
goalTranslations.en: Add an existing employee to a named group for a given period.
goalTranslations.fr: Ajouter un employé existant à un groupe donné pour une période définie.
goalTranslations.it: Aggiungere un dipendente esistente a un gruppo per un periodo definito.

steps.prompt: Ask the user which group the employee should be added to (the group name).

promptTranslations.de: Zu welcher Gruppe soll der Mitarbeiter hinzugefügt werden (Gruppenname)?
promptTranslations.en: Which group should the employee be added to (the group name)?
promptTranslations.fr: À quel groupe l'employé doit-il être ajouté (nom du groupe) ?
promptTranslations.it: A quale gruppo deve essere aggiunto il dipendente (nome del gruppo)?

steps.description: the name of the group the employee should be added to

steps.note: Find the target group. The search term is supplied. The recipe captures the matching group automatically when exactly one group matches.

steps.prompt: Ask the user for the name of the employee (client) to add to the group.

promptTranslations.de: Wie heisst der Mitarbeiter, der zur Gruppe hinzugefügt werden soll (Vor- und Nachname)?
promptTranslations.en: What is the name of the employee to add to the group (first and last name)?
promptTranslations.fr: Quel est le nom de l'employé à ajouter au groupe (prénom et nom) ?
promptTranslations.it: Qual è il nome del dipendente da aggiungere al gruppo (nome e cognome)?

steps.description: the full name (first and last name) of the employee to add

steps.note: Find the employee. The search term is supplied. The recipe captures the matching employee automatically when exactly one matches.

steps.prompt: Ask the user from which date the group membership should be valid (valid-until is optional).

promptTranslations.de: Ab welchem Datum soll die Gruppenmitgliedschaft gültig sein (Enddatum optional)?
promptTranslations.en: From which date should the group membership be valid (valid-until is optional)?
promptTranslations.fr: À partir de quelle date l'appartenance au groupe doit-elle être valable (date de fin facultative) ?
promptTranslations.it: Da quale data deve essere valida l'appartenenza al gruppo (data di fine facoltativa)?

steps.description: the start date from which the group membership is valid

steps.note: Add the employee to the group now. clientId, groupId and validFrom are supplied — do not ask for them again. This skill rejects duplicates, so it safely refuses if the employee is already in the group.

recipes.name: bulk-add-employees-to-group
recipes.goal: Bulk-add all employees matching criteria (canton/region and/or contract) to a named group, previewing the matches before applying.

goalTranslations.de: Alle Mitarbeiter, die bestimmten Kriterien entsprechen (Kanton/Region und/oder Vertrag), einer Gruppe hinzufügen — mit Vorschau vor dem Übernehmen.
goalTranslations.en: Bulk-add all employees matching criteria (canton/region and/or contract) to a named group, previewing before applying.
goalTranslations.fr: Ajouter en masse tous les employés correspondant aux critères (canton/région et/ou contrat) à un groupe, avec aperçu avant application.
goalTranslations.it: Aggiungere in blocco tutti i dipendenti che soddisfano i criteri (cantone/regione e/o contratto) a un gruppo, con anteprima prima dell'applicazione.

steps.prompt: Ask the user into which group the matching employees should be added (the group name).

promptTranslations.de: In welche Gruppe sollen die passenden Mitarbeiter aufgenommen werden (Gruppenname)?
promptTranslations.en: Into which group should the matching employees be added (the group name)?
promptTranslations.fr: Dans quel groupe les employés correspondants doivent-ils être ajoutés (nom du groupe) ?
promptTranslations.it: In quale gruppo devono essere aggiunti i dipendenti corrispondenti (nome del gruppo)?

steps.description: the name of the target group to fill

steps.prompt: Ask by which criteria the employees should be selected — for example a canton/region and/or a contract name.

promptTranslations.de: Nach welchen Kriterien sollen die Mitarbeiter ausgewählt werden — zum Beispiel Kanton/Region und/oder Vertragsname?
promptTranslations.en: By which criteria should the employees be selected — for example a canton/region and/or a contract name?
promptTranslations.fr: Selon quels critères les employés doivent-ils être sélectionnés — par exemple un canton/une région et/ou un nom de contrat ?
promptTranslations.it: In base a quali criteri devono essere selezionati i dipendenti — per esempio un cantone/una regione e/o un nome di contratto?

steps.description: the selection criteria, e.g. a canton/region and/or a contract name

steps.prompt: Ask the user from which date the new group memberships should be valid (the start date applied to all added members). Accept a concrete date like 2026-05-01 or 'today'.

promptTranslations.de: Ab welchem Datum sollen die neuen Gruppenmitgliedschaften gültig sein (z. B. 2026-05-01 oder 'heute')?
promptTranslations.en: From which date should the new group memberships be valid (e.g. 2026-05-01 or 'today')?
promptTranslations.fr: À partir de quelle date les nouvelles appartenances au groupe doivent-elles être valables (p. ex. 2026-05-01 ou « aujourd'hui ») ?
promptTranslations.it: Da quale data devono essere valide le nuove appartenenze al gruppo (per es. 2026-05-01 o 'oggi')?

steps.description: the start date (valid-from) for the new memberships

steps.note: Bulk-fill the group. groupName and validFrom are supplied — do not ask for them again. Map the user's criteria (see the known values below) to the optional parameters canton (a Swiss canton code like 'BE', or a canton name) and/or contractName. ALWAYS call with apply=false first to return a preview of who would be added; never set apply=true until the user has explicitly confirmed the previewed list. Relay the preview, and on apply relay the added and verified counts from the skill result to the user.

recipes.name: add-absence-for-employee
recipes.goal: Place an absence (Break) on an existing employee for a given date and absence type.

goalTranslations.de: Eine Abwesenheit für einen bestehenden Mitarbeiter an einem bestimmten Datum mit einer Absenzart erfassen.
goalTranslations.en: Place an absence on an existing employee for a given date and absence type.
goalTranslations.fr: Enregistrer une absence pour un employé existant à une date donnée avec un type d'absence.
goalTranslations.it: Registrare un'assenza per un dipendente esistente in una data specifica con un tipo di assenza.

steps.prompt: Ask the user for the full name (first and last name) of the employee the absence is for.

promptTranslations.de: Wie heisst der Mitarbeiter, für den die Abwesenheit erfasst werden soll (Vor- und Nachname)?
promptTranslations.en: What is the full name (first and last name) of the employee the absence is for?
promptTranslations.fr: Quel est le nom complet (prénom et nom) de l'employé concerné par l'absence ?
promptTranslations.it: Qual è il nome completo (nome e cognome) del dipendente a cui si riferisce l'assenza?

steps.description: the full name (first and last name) of the employee the absence is for

steps.note: Find the employee. The search term and entityType='Employee' are supplied — customers and external employees are excluded from the search. The recipe captures the matching employee automatically when exactly one matches.

steps.prompt: Ask the user what kind of absence it is (e.g. vacation, sick, training, unpaid leave).

promptTranslations.de: Um welche Art von Abwesenheit handelt es sich (z. B. Ferien, Krankheit, Schulung, unbezahlter Urlaub)?
promptTranslations.en: What kind of absence is it (e.g. vacation, sick, training, unpaid leave)?
promptTranslations.fr: De quel type d'absence s'agit-il (p. ex. vacances, maladie, formation, congé non payé) ?
promptTranslations.it: Di che tipo di assenza si tratta (per es. ferie, malattia, formazione, congedo non pagato)?

steps.description: the kind of absence (vacation, sick, training, ...)

steps.prompt: Ask the user for the date of the absence.

promptTranslations.de: An welchem Datum ist die Abwesenheit?
promptTranslations.en: On which date is the absence?
promptTranslations.fr: À quelle date a lieu l'absence ?
promptTranslations.it: In quale data si verifica l'assenza?

steps.description: the date of the absence as a calendar date (yyyy-MM-dd)

steps.note: List the available absence types so their IDs are known for the next step. Do not ask the user anything here; just call list_absence_types and read its result.

Place the absence now. clientId is supplied — do not ask for it. Choose absenceId from the absence types that list_absence_types just returned by matching the kind of absence the user named (see known values below). Use the date the user gave (known values) as date, formatted yyyy-MM-dd. Leave startTime, endTime and workTime at their defaults unless the user explicitly specified them.

recipes.name: bulk-add-absence-for-group
recipes.goal: Place the same absence (e.g. a training day / Schulung) on every member of a named group for a single date, previewing the affected members before applying.

goalTranslations.de: Dieselbe Abwesenheit (z. B. eine Schulung) für alle Mitglieder einer Gruppe an einem Datum erfassen — mit Vorschau vor dem Übernehmen.
goalTranslations.en: Place the same absence (e.g. a training day) on every member of a named group for a single date, previewing before applying.
goalTranslations.fr: Enregistrer la même absence (p. ex. une journée de formation) pour tous les membres d'un groupe à une date donnée, avec aperçu avant application.
goalTranslations.it: Registrare la stessa assenza (per es. una giornata di formazione) per tutti i membri di un gruppo in una data specifica, con anteprima prima dell'applicazione.

steps.prompt: Ask the user for the name of the group whose members should get the absence.

promptTranslations.de: Wie heisst die Gruppe, deren Mitglieder die Abwesenheit erhalten sollen?
promptTranslations.en: What is the name of the group whose members should get the absence?
promptTranslations.fr: Quel est le nom du groupe dont les membres doivent recevoir l'absence ?
promptTranslations.it: Qual è il nome del gruppo i cui membri devono ricevere l'assenza?

steps.description: the name of the group whose members get the absence

steps.prompt: Ask the user what kind of absence it is (e.g. training/Schulung, vacation, sick).

promptTranslations.de: Um welche Art von Abwesenheit handelt es sich (z. B. Schulung, Ferien, Krankheit)?
promptTranslations.en: What kind of absence is it (e.g. training, vacation, sick)?
promptTranslations.fr: De quel type d'absence s'agit-il (p. ex. formation, vacances, maladie) ?
promptTranslations.it: Di che tipo di assenza si tratta (per es. formazione, ferie, malattia)?

steps.description: the kind of absence to place (e.g. Schulung, Ferien, Krank)

steps.prompt: Ask the user for the date of the absence.

promptTranslations.de: An welchem Datum ist die Abwesenheit?
promptTranslations.en: On which date is the absence?
promptTranslations.fr: À quelle date a lieu l'absence ?
promptTranslations.it: In quale data si verifica l'assenza?

steps.description: the date of the absence as a calendar date (yyyy-MM-dd)

steps.note: Bulk-place the absence on all members of the group. groupName, absenceType and date are supplied — do not ask for them. ALWAYS call with apply=false first to return a preview of how many members would get the absence; never set apply=true until the user has explicitly confirmed. Relay the preview, and on apply relay the added and verified counts from the skill result to the user.

recipes.name: create-group
recipes.goal: Create a new group (root level or nested under a parent) with a name, validity start date and holiday calendar.

goalTranslations.de: Eine neue Gruppe erstellen (auf oberster Ebene oder unter einer übergeordneten Gruppe) mit Name, Gültigkeitsbeginn und Feiertagskalender.
goalTranslations.en: Create a new group (root level or nested under a parent) with a name, validity start date and holiday calendar.
goalTranslations.fr: Créer un nouveau groupe (au niveau racine ou sous un groupe parent) avec un nom, une date de début de validité et un calendrier des jours fériés.
goalTranslations.it: Creare un nuovo gruppo (a livello principale o sotto un gruppo padre) con nome, data di inizio validità e calendario festivo.

steps.prompt: Ask the user for the name of the new group.

promptTranslations.de: Wie soll die neue Gruppe heissen?
promptTranslations.en: What should the new group be called?
promptTranslations.fr: Quel nom doit porter le nouveau groupe ?
promptTranslations.it: Come deve chiamarsi il nuovo gruppo?

steps.description: the name of the new group

steps.prompt: Ask the user from which date the new group is valid (valid-until is optional).

promptTranslations.de: Ab welchem Datum ist die neue Gruppe gültig (Enddatum optional)?
promptTranslations.en: From which date is the new group valid (valid-until is optional)?
promptTranslations.fr: À partir de quelle date le nouveau groupe est-il valable (date de fin facultative) ?
promptTranslations.it: Da quale data è valido il nuovo gruppo (data di fine facoltativa)?

steps.description: the start date from which the new group is valid

steps.prompt: Ask the user where the group should sit: at the top level (root), or nested under an existing parent group. If nested, ask for the parent group's name.

promptTranslations.de: Wo soll die Gruppe eingeordnet werden: auf oberster Ebene (Wurzel) oder unter einer bestehenden übergeordneten Gruppe? Falls untergeordnet: Wie heisst die übergeordnete Gruppe?
promptTranslations.en: Where should the group sit: at the top level (root) or nested under an existing parent group? If nested, what is the parent group's name?
promptTranslations.fr: Où le groupe doit-il se situer : au niveau racine ou sous un groupe parent existant ? Si sous un parent : quel est le nom du groupe parent ?
promptTranslations.it: Dove deve essere collocato il gruppo: al livello principale (radice) o sotto un gruppo padre esistente? Se sotto un padre: qual è il nome del gruppo padre?

steps.description: where the group belongs: 'root' / top level, or the name of the parent group to nest it under

steps.prompt: Ask the user which holiday calendar the group should use (e.g. a canton like 'Kanton Zürich').

promptTranslations.de: Welchen Feiertagskalender soll die Gruppe verwenden (z. B. 'Kanton Zürich')?
promptTranslations.en: Which holiday calendar should the group use (e.g. 'Kanton Zürich')?
promptTranslations.fr: Quel calendrier des jours fériés le groupe doit-il utiliser (p. ex. « Kanton Zürich ») ?
promptTranslations.it: Quale calendario festivo deve usare il gruppo (per es. 'Kanton Zürich')?

steps.description: the name of the holiday calendar for the group (e.g. a canton)

steps.note: Find the holiday calendar. The search term is supplied. The recipe captures the matching calendar automatically when exactly one matches.

Look up candidate parent groups for the placement the user gave. Just call list_groups and read its result; do not ask anything. If the placement is 'root' / top level, this lookup simply finds nothing relevant — that is fine.

Create the group now. name and calendarId are supplied — do not ask for them. Use the start date the user gave (see the known values below) as validFrom, formatted yyyy-MM-dd. PLACEMENT: if the user chose root / top level / 'Wurzel', or did NOT name an existing parent group, do NOT pass parentId (the group is created at root level). ONLY if the user named an existing parent group, set parentId to that group's Id from the list_groups result above. The payment interval defaults to Monthly.

recipes.name: add-shift-to-group
recipes.goal: Add an existing shift/order to a named group.

goalTranslations.de: Einen bestehenden Dienst/eine Bestellung einer Gruppe hinzufügen.
goalTranslations.en: Add an existing shift/order to a named group.
goalTranslations.fr: Ajouter un service/une commande existant(e) à un groupe donné.
goalTranslations.it: Aggiungere un servizio/ordine esistente a un gruppo.

steps.prompt: Ask the user for the name of the shift/order to add to the group.

promptTranslations.de: Wie heisst der Dienst/die Bestellung, der/die zur Gruppe hinzugefügt werden soll?
promptTranslations.en: What is the name of the shift/order to add to the group?
promptTranslations.fr: Quel est le nom du service/de la commande à ajouter au groupe ?
promptTranslations.it: Qual è il nome del servizio/ordine da aggiungere al gruppo?

steps.description: the name of the shift/order to add to the group

steps.note: Find the shift. The search string is supplied. The recipe captures the matching shift automatically when exactly one shift matches.

steps.prompt: Ask the user for the name of the group the shift should be added to.

promptTranslations.de: Zu welcher Gruppe soll der Dienst hinzugefügt werden (Gruppenname)?
promptTranslations.en: Which group should the shift be added to (the group name)?
promptTranslations.fr: À quel groupe le service doit-il être ajouté (nom du groupe) ?
promptTranslations.it: A quale gruppo deve essere aggiunto il servizio (nome del gruppo)?

steps.description: the name of the group the shift should be added to

steps.note: Find the target group. The search term is supplied. The recipe captures the matching group automatically when exactly one group matches.
Add the shift to the group now. shiftId and groupId are supplied — do not ask for them. This skill rejects duplicates, so it safely refuses if the shift is already in the group.

recipes.name: bulk-add-shifts-to-group
recipes.goal: Bulk-add all shifts/orders matching a search term to a named group, previewing the matches before applying.

goalTranslations.de: Alle Dienste/Bestellungen, die einem Suchbegriff entsprechen, einer Gruppe hinzufügen — mit Vorschau vor dem Übernehmen.

steps.prompt: Ask the user for the name of the customer to place into the nearest group.

promptTranslations.de: Wie heisst der Kunde, der in die nächstgelegene Gruppe aufgenommen werden soll?
promptTranslations.en: What is the name of the customer to place into the nearest group?
promptTranslations.fr: Quel est le nom du client à placer dans le groupe le plus proche ?
promptTranslations.it: Qual è il nome del cliente da inserire nel gruppo più vicino?

steps.description: the name (or company) of the customer to place into the nearest group

steps.note: Find the customer. The search term and entityType='Customer' are supplied — employees and external employees are excluded from the search. The recipe captures the matching customer automatically when exactly one matches.

steps.prompt: Ask the user from which date the new group membership should be valid (the start date). Accept a concrete date like 2026-05-01 or 'today'.

promptTranslations.de: Ab welchem Datum soll die neue Gruppenmitgliedschaft gültig sein (z. B. 2026-05-01 oder 'heute')?

steps.description: the start date (valid-from) for the new membership

steps.note: Place the customer into the geographically nearest group now. clientId and validFrom are supplied — do not ask for them again. The nearest group is derived from group coordinates (geocoded from group names). If the customer has no geocoded address or no group carries coordinates, the skill leaves it unchanged and explains why — relay that explanation.

recipes.name: bulk-add-customers-to-nearest-group
recipes.goal: Bulk re-assign every customer to its geographically nearest location group, previewing the proposed moves before applying.

goalTranslations.de: Alle Kunden ihrer jeweils geografisch nächstgelegenen Standortgruppe zuordnen — mit Vorschau der Verschiebungen vor dem Übernehmen.
goalTranslations.en: Bulk re-assign every customer to its geographically nearest location group, previewing the proposed moves before applying.
goalTranslations.fr: Réaffecter en masse chaque client à son groupe d'emplacement géographiquement le plus proche, avec aperçu des déplacements avant application.
goalTranslations.it: Riassegnare in blocco ogni cliente al gruppo di sede geograficamente più vicino, con anteprima degli spostamenti prima dell'applicazione.

steps.note: Re-distribute ALL customers to their geographically nearest location group. This recipe takes no per-customer input — it operates on the whole customer base. ALWAYS call propose_customer_grouping first (a read-only dry run): relay the proposed move count, the per-target-group breakdown and any customers that cannot be placed. Do NOT persist anything yet. Only after the user explicitly confirms, call apply_customer_grouping to persist the moves — that skill verifies every new membership in the database and returns added/verified counts; relay those verified counts to the user. If no group carries coordinates, tell the user to geocode the location groups first via geocode_location_groups.

recipes.name: setup-owner-address
recipes.goal: Configure the company/owner's global holiday calendar for scheduling, resolving the calendar name to its ID.

goalTranslations.de: Den globalen Feiertagskalender des Unternehmens für die Planung konfigurieren.
goalTranslations.en: Configure the company's global holiday calendar for scheduling.
goalTranslations.fr: Configurer le calendrier global des jours fériés de l'entreprise pour la planification.
goalTranslations.it: Configurare il calendario festivo globale dell'azienda per la pianificazione.

steps.prompt: Ask the user which holiday/global calendar the company should use for scheduling (e.g. a canton like 'Kanton Zürich' or a country-wide calendar).

promptTranslations.de: Welchen Feiertagskalender soll das Unternehmen für die Planung verwenden (z. B. 'Kanton Zürich' oder ein landesweiter Kalender)?
promptTranslations.en: Which holiday calendar should the company use for scheduling (e.g. 'Kanton Zürich' or a country-wide calendar)?
promptTranslations.fr: Quel calendrier des jours fériés l'entreprise doit-elle utiliser pour la planification (p. ex. « Kanton Zürich » ou un calendrier national) ?
promptTranslations.it: Quale calendario festivo deve usare l'azienda per la pianificazione (per es. 'Kanton Zürich' o un calendario nazionale)?

steps.description: the name of the holiday calendar to configure for the company (e.g. a canton)

steps.note: Find the holiday calendar matching the name given. The recipe captures the match automatically when exactly one result matches.

Set the company's global holiday calendar now. calendarId is supplied. If the user also mentioned the country, state/canton or time zone anywhere in this conversation, pass those too as country/state/timeZone (country and state as ISO abbreviations, e.g. CH/ZH; timeZone as an IANA identifier, e.g. Europe/Zurich) — otherwise omit them so existing values stay unchanged. Relay the confirmation, including which calendar is now active.
